notes.title: STEAMDECK UPDATE ( + Full controller compatibility)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44163129/596787ca041d542c41d7ec8f2e6b7da5f5b989f4.png

Hello !

We are really happy to announce the Steamdeck release for Time Handlers!

This update also includes a full controller compatibility for every versions !

Note: There is a possibility that some decks may need to set a compatibility in the settings > Compatibility > Check the checkbox without any other action


If you find any bug or issue, please let us know by sending us an email at : mike(at)patatedouce-studio.fr


PS: We would be very grateful if anybody who like the game would post a review on the steam page ! This helps us a lot


Thanks a lot for your support

notes.content:

notes.title: Grab your mate for the release !
notes.content:
We are thrilled to officially announce the release of our first game ever, "Time Handlers"! After months of passionate effort, bursts of creativity, and sleepless nights, our team is excited to invite you to dive into this coop adventure.

We started this project a year ago and as our first game, we tried to make everything perfect for our players. 

Available Now!
Time Handlers is now available on Steam. Dive into the adventure right away and share your discoveries with the community. 
We want to thank every person who contributed to making this dream a reality ! 

For 1 week starting on release date (11th january 2024), get the game for -20% on Steam shop !
What are you waiting for ? #GrabYourMate !
